subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up — DeepFin startup request
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@deepfin.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: pricing numbers from today

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — Jason from DeepFin here. Quick follow-up on pricing so I can take numbers back to the founders and ops:

- Expected token volumes: initial pilot ~20M tokens/month (prompt+generation), ramp to ~50–70M over 6 months, long-term target 150M+/month.
- Typical sequence lengths: avg 850 tokens/request, with a small tail to 2k for long reports.
- Our rough budget: trying to keep costs <= $30k/month in the pilot, but founders want to understand unit economics and a target $/1M tokens they can plan for (ballpark).

We're an early-stage startup (seed + a small VC lead) — are there any startup credits/programs or committed-use discounts we should consider? Ideally we want to know the price per 1M tokens at the following commitment levels: 10M/mo, 50M/mo, and 150M/mo. Also curious if multi-year pricing or invoice terms would change the unit rate.

Attached is a short volume forecast we sketched out.

Attachment: DeepFin_Monthly_Volumes.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if easier.

Best,
Jason
Co-founder, DeepFin
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@deepfin.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing numbers from today

Hi Jason — thanks for the clear recap and the volume file, that helps a lot. Recapping for the thread and putting some concrete options on the table based on what we discussed today: 

Quick recap of what I heard:
- Pilot: ~20M tokens/month with potential to ramp to 50–70M in 6 months, long-term 150M+.
- Sequence profile: ~850 tokens/req average.
- Budget: pilot target ~ $30k/month.

Pricing and options (ballpark, subject to final SOW/signature):
1) Hosted list price (no commitment): $2,200 / 1M tokens (this is the base reference for quotes).
2) Startup program: eligible startups get $10k in platform credits + an introductory 30% off list for the first 3 months (applies only to hosted usage).
3) Committed-use tiers (monthly commit, 12-month term):
   - 10M/mo commit: 10% off list => ~$1,980 / 1M
   - 50M/mo commit: 25% off list => ~$1,650 / 1M
   - 150M/mo commit: 35% off list => ~$1,430 / 1M
4) Multi-year incentive: 2-year committed contracts can add an additional 5–10% discount on top of committed tiers (depends on invoicing cadence and legal).

Example: if DeepFin does a 12-month 50M/mo commit, the effective unit would be ~ $1,650 / 1M tokens; at 150M/mo commit that's ~ $1,430 / 1M. I did the math in the attached sheet.

Given your budget constraint (~$30k/mo for pilot), a 20M/mo pilot at list would be ~$44k/month; with the startup program + a small commit (10M/mo) you'd get that within range (credits + discounts). We can design a stepped commit (start 20M pilot, 12-month 50M target ramp) and align credits to the first quarter to help free cash flow.

A couple clarifying Qs that will affect exact pricing:
- Do you need a dedicated / private deployment or is hosted API acceptable for pilot? (Dedicated usually has a different pricing/commit profile.)
- Is invoicing in USD and net-30 standard for you? Any requirement for PO or tax forms?

Next steps I propose:
- If hosted API is fine, I can draft a proposed SOW with the 12-month ramp and show the exact monthly invoice table (including startup credits).
- If you want an upfront committed quote for 50M/mo, I can loop Ben (pricing approvals) and Aditya (startup program/admin) to finalize the numbers and SOW.

I'll also attach the volume workbook back with the scenarios filled in.

Attachment: DeepFin_Monthly_Volumes.xlsx (updated, 24KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: Pricing & commitment follow-up — DeepFin startup request

Ben / Aditya — forwarding DeepFin's ask. Pilot numbers look reasonable but they are asking to stack startup program + committed discount and would like to see a 12-month ramp to 50M/mo.

Key points:
- Initial pilot 20M/mo (target ~$30k/month budget).
- They want to know committed rates for 10M/50M/150M thresholds and whether multi-year adds more discount.
- They're a seed-stage startup with a VC; eligible for the startup program per my review but will need admin approval for credits.

Can we do the following?
1) Approve stacking startup 30% intro + committed tier for the first 3 months (credits apply first, then discount).
2) Approve a deeper one-time commercial exception for the first 12 months: 35% total off list on a 12-month 50M/mo commit (this would be higher than standard 25% if we can approve a promo to accelerate adoption).

I attached the volumes sheet and a proposed SOW outline — if you approve, I'll send the SOW and get signature.

Quoted material below for context:
> Pricing and options (ballpark, subject to final SOW/signature):
> 1) Hosted list price (no commitment): $2,200 / 1M tokens
> 2) Startup program: $10k credits + 30% off first 3 months
> 3) Committed-use tiers: 10M=10%, 50M=25%, 150M=35%

Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (draft)
Attachment: DeepFin_Monthly_Volumes.xlsx

Thanks — LMK if you want to reduce the concession or change the term.

Regards,
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & commitment follow-up — DeepFin startup request

Marissa — thanks for the context and the proposed commercial. Approved with the following guardrails:

- Approve stacking startup program (30% intro) + committed discount for the first 3 months.
- Approve a one-time commercial exception of 35% off list for months 1–12 on a 12-month, 50M/mo commitment, provided the customer signs the SOW and we secure a PO or signed agreement before kickoff.
- After month 12, standard committed tiers revert (25% at 50M/mo), unless they sign a 2-year agreement (in which case we can discuss the additional 5% multi-year incentive).

Please proceed to:
1) Send the SOW (attach SOW_v1.pdf) with the approved commercial terms.
2) Add clause about credits applying to hosted usage only.
3) Ask for a PO or signature + billing contact.

Loop in Legal only if any bespoke legal language comes up; for standard SOW we can use template. Good work — keep trials to hosted unless they specifically request Dedicated.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
